scope: merchant stock ownership, deterministic quote arithmetic, atomic buying and selling, quantity, stack, capacity, and rollback semantics

sources.observations: The cumulative runtime provides checked wallet balances, account limits, canonical denomination conversion, deterministic wallet locking, snapshots, and rollback-safe ownership transfer.
The authoritative repository baseline was previously documented as containing transactional economy services, guarded debits, checked credits, ledgers, and trade ownership boundaries.

assumptions: Merchant pricing modifiers are represented as explicit data-driven basis points rather than hard-coded MajorMUD constants.
A commerce transaction must either commit merchandise and payment together or restore all participating snapshots.
Quest items and items explicitly marked non-sellable are rejected before merchant payment.
Unlimited stock is virtual and is not decremented or incremented.
fallback: Reject unknown items, invalid quantities, unsupported stock, insufficient funds, capacity overflow, stack overflow, merchant refusal, merchant stock overflow, wallet mismatch, and checked arithmetic overflow; restore every participant on any failure.
runtimeImpact: Adds executable shop purchase and sale transactions over the currency runtime with deterministic data-driven pricing and full rollback.
saveImpact: Adds versioned inventory and merchant-stock snapshots suitable for persistence binding; this pass does not invent native save timing.
worldImpact: Prevents partial purchases, partial sales, duplicated items, lost currency, merchant-wallet substitution, stock underflow, stock overflow, and capacity bypass.
unknownNativeDependencies: MajorMUD 1.11p item base values and merchant records
charisma, reputation, alignment, race, class, skill, ability, condition, limited-stock, world, and random modifiers
